comparison.objective: Test two self-closing gates, tag the one that stays open, and leave both shut; candidate removes four HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Gate actuation, observation of passive closure, fault tagging, and final closure versus precision impact tooling and fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: Faulty gate correctly identified/tagged and both gates left shut versus four controlled fractures, retained inserts, no damage, and complete containment.
comparison.reason: Functional inspection and fault marking are materially different from fracture mechanics. The record body and closure timing/angle thresholds are absent.
